scope: A1 independent installed Python process ownership and rollback for external Markdown images on the current local filesystem
input: Two independently generated python-docx DOCX packages: same picture basename, red/blue or blue/blue payload and Chinese paragraph

scenarios.claim: Hold the first process after exclusive marker creation; run the second to completion before releasing the first. Both final Markdown links resolve to the right red/blue pixels.
scenarios.rollback: Hold a first process with a published pending blue image before ASCII encoding; second same-content export completes; release first to fail. Original first Markdown and second output/image remain, failed first image and marker disappear.
scenarios.interrupted: Kill a held process after image rendering. The original main file remains, pending marker and image remain, and a new independent process safely chooses another name. No automatic deletion/recovery claimed.

evidence.processes: Actual Popen/subprocess.run interpreters, distinct reported PIDs, module origin matched against the installed parent package; both handles reaped
evidence.images: Pillow decodes final image pixels after both processes finish; actual Markdown links checked
evidence.baseline: 46ea8f7 wheel extracted to /tmp/docweave-image-rollback-baseline: rollback case fails because successful second output reuses assets/image.png, 1 failed, 2 deselected in 0.92s

changes: Tests and acceptance documentation only; production package bytes match the already built/installed wheel, no production change or dependency added
remaining: No power-loss atomicity or automatic stale-marker recovery
Cross-platform results depend on the latest CI; not implied by local macOS results
